generated_response: Dijkstra's algorithm is an algorithm used to find the shortest path between two points in a graph with non-negative edge weights. It solves the single-source shortest path problem (SSSP). The algorithm works by starting from a source node and iteratively relaxing its neighbors, updating their distances until it reaches all other nodes or finds the shortest path. The time complexity of Dijkstra's algorithm is O(V + E log V), where V is the number of vertices and E is the number of edges in the graph.
